title: A service (S) invoice with no vehicle also lands in the Parts Sales bucket — absence of a vehicle decides, not the prefix
custom_preconds: 1. A customer has an invoice whose number starts with S but whose work order has NO vehicle (seed a ZZAUTOTEST no-vehicle service work order and invoice it, if the app allows).
custom_steps:
1. Expand that customer.
2. Find which asset row the S invoice sits under.
custom_expected: 1. The no-vehicle S invoice appears under that customer's "Parts Sales" row — the bucket collects work by the ABSENCE of a vehicle, not by the invoice-number prefix.
